_注: 0th拡張33種の効果文（英語）。cardId が鍵。tools/gen-ex0-text.mjs が読む。
🔴 用語は src/card-text.en.js の頭にある対応表に合わせること（自分で言い方を発明しない）:
ロック=lock / ロックエリア=Lock Area / 山札=deck / 捨て場=discard pile / 手札=hand /
ドロー=draw / マス=space / 駒=piece / ゲート=Gate / 到達効果=Arrival Effect /
手札効果=Hand Effect / 基本効果=Basic Effect / 移動=move / 強制移動=forced move /
表向き=face-up / 裏向き=face-down / オープンする=flip face-up / 公開する=reveal /
宣言する=declare / 接触=contact / 相手=opponent / 全員=each player /
追色N=Color Cost N / このフェイズを終了する=End this phase.
⚠ 隣・周囲はどちらも adjacent（リメイクの英語がそう訳してある）。
⚠ {白} {黒} は絵の印なので、英語でもそのまま残す。

ex0-orange-bus.arrival: Move to the space with Bus Stop. Place this face-up adjacent to you. Add that Bus Stop to your hand.
ex0-orange-bus.hand: Place this face-up on any space that is not adjacent to you.
ex0-orange-bus.flavor: Those who board cannot choose where they go. They can only choose the courage to get off.

ex0-yellow-reach-cancel.arrival: You are forced to move to the space you were on before moving.
ex0-yellow-reach-cancel.hand: Usable immediately before a non-colorless card's Arrival Effect is resolved. Nullify that card's effect and discard that card.
ex0-yellow-reach-cancel.flavor: A hand that almost reached was quietly drawn back.

ex0-green-lost-forest.arrival: Draw 1 card. Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of 4 spaces with no card. Discard all cards adjacent to you.
ex0-green-lost-forest.hand: Place this face-up on a space with no player that is not adjacent to you.
ex0-green-lost-forest.flavor: The footprints multiply. Only the way home grows fewer.

ex0-blue-appraiser.arrival: Look at the face of the face-down card on any 1 space.
ex0-blue-appraiser.hand: Declare 2 colors. Flip the face-down card on 1 space with no player face-up and add it to your hand. If that card is a declared color, repeat from the beginning. End this phase.
ex0-blue-appraiser.flavor: Show me the back. The price comes after that. (the Appraiser)

ex0-pink-wish-for-peace.arrival: At the start of your next turn, if you are on this card and no one has used a hand effect in the meantime, each player draws 2 cards and this card is turned face-down. Otherwise, add this to your hand.
ex0-pink-wish-for-peace.hand: Draw 1 card. Place this face-down on any space that is not adjacent to you.
ex0-pink-wish-for-peace.flavor: Anyone can wish. Staying silent is the hard part.

ex0-purple-hidden-fortune.arrival: Choose 1 space with a card on it other than the space you are on. Place 1 card from the deck or your hand face-up at the bottom of that space.
ex0-purple-hidden-fortune.flavor: Treasure belongs to the one who finds it, not the one who hid it.

ex0-red-beginning.arrival: Add the top card of the discard pile to your hand.
ex0-red-beginning.hand: Add the second card from the top of the discard pile to your hand. End this phase.
ex0-red-beginning.flavor: That innocent face truly carried the will of red. Was this flame handed to him, or his own?

ex0-orange-bus-stop.arrival: Do not add this to your hand. If this was flipped face-up this turn, draw 1 card.
ex0-orange-bus-stop.hand:
Gain one of the following effects:
・Discard 1 card from your hand. Place this face-up on any space.
・Place this face-down on any space.
ex0-orange-bus-stop.flavor: Some days nobody comes. The sign stands all the same.

ex0-yellow-gate-charge.arrival: Draw 1 card. If this was flipped face-up this turn, place this face-up on your Gate. Otherwise, you are forced to move to the space you were on before moving and discard this. However, you cannot move onto an opponent's Gate.
ex0-yellow-gate-charge.hand: Place this face-up on your Gate.
ex0-yellow-gate-charge.flavor: Preparations are piled up in the hope of never needing them.

ex0-green-creation.arrival: Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of 4 empty spaces. Flip them face-up.
ex0-green-creation.flavor: To create is not to place, but to open.

ex0-blue-strict-watch.arrival:
Gain one of the following effects:
・Discard down to 1 card in hand.
・You are forced to move to your Gate; do not flip the card on the destination face-up.
ex0-blue-strict-watch.hand: Place this face-up on a space with no player.
ex0-blue-strict-watch.flavor: None shall pass from here. Not even an ally. (the Gatekeeper)

ex0-pink-mystic-fruit.arrival: If you have an even number of cards in hand, draw 1 card.
ex0-pink-mystic-fruit.hand: Usable when 2 or more spaces adjacent to you have cards on them. The opponent on your right moves you 1 space. End this phase.
ex0-pink-mystic-fruit.flavor: The stranger a thing looks, the less people hesitate to taste it.

ex0-purple-redo-key.arrival: You may discard any number of cards from your hand. Draw that many cards.
ex0-purple-redo-key.hand: Usable when an opponent declares a lock. That opponent cannot lock this turn.
ex0-purple-redo-key.flavor: The key that stops and the key that opens have the same shape.

ex0-flute-red.arrival:
Gain one of the following effects:
・Add 1 face-up card of this card's color on the field to your hand.
・Flip the card on any 1 space face-up.
ex0-flute-red.flavor: A color answers when it is called.

ex0-red-joyner.arrival: You are forced to move 1 space.
ex0-red-joyner.hand: Repeat any number of times: you are forced to move to an empty space adjacent to you. End this turn.
ex0-red-joyner.flavor: I keep running where there is nothing, and that is how I notice what matters. (Joyner the Runner)

ex0-orange-mccool.arrival: Add 2 cards from spaces adjacent to you to your hand.
ex0-orange-mccool.hand: 【Color Cost 1】Choose 1 opponent. You are forced to move adjacent to that opponent; do not flip the card on the destination face-up. End this turn.
ex0-orange-mccool.flavor: I am special. And you? You are special too, of course. Do notice it soon. (McCool the Gifted)

ex0-yellow-little-mouse.arrival: Choose 1 player who has locked the most. Add 2 cards at random from that player's hand to your hand.
ex0-yellow-little-mouse.hand: Usable at any time. Gain the Arrival Effect above. If you used it on your own turn, end this turn.
ex0-yellow-little-mouse.flavor: The weak, the strong. One day I will take unfairness itself from this world. (Little Mouse the Great Thief)

ex0-green-peterhood.arrival: Place 3 cards face-down from the deck on each space adjacent to you.
ex0-green-peterhood.hand: Choose a number from 1 to 7. Each player draws or discards until they have that many cards in hand. End this phase.
ex0-green-peterhood.flavor: Nature nurtures, and is equal to all. I wish to be the same. (Peterhood of the Forest)

ex0-blue-jake.arrival: Look at the faces of the face-down cards on any 7 spaces.
ex0-blue-jake.hand: Declare 1 color. Flip the face-down card on 1 space with no player face-up. If that card is the declared color, repeat from the beginning, but you may flip at most 7 cards in total. If the 7th card is the declared color, add those 7 cards to your hand. End this turn.
ex0-blue-jake.flavor: I want to know more of this world. Its past, and its future. (Jake the Historian)

ex0-pink-yaeza.arrival:
Choose 1 opponent. That opponent adds this to their hand and gains one of the following effects:
・Discard their entire hand. Draw 1 card.
・Discard 1 of their locked cards.
ex0-pink-yaeza.flavor: By the time you notice, I will have taken it all from you. (Yaeza the Alluring)

ex0-purple-vivian.arrival: Choose 1 opponent. That opponent takes a Move Phase. If that opponent would add the card they arrive at to their hand, add that card to your hand instead.
ex0-purple-vivian.flavor: A world overflowing with kindness. That is what I wish for. (Vivian the Patron)

ex0-white-pure-burger.arrival: Choose 1 space with no player. Each player draws 1 card and places 1 card from their hand on top of that space.
ex0-white-pure-burger.hand: Choose any 1 space. Draw as many cards as there are face-down cards on that space.
ex0-white-pure-burger.flavor: At a table that is shared, nobody has lost anything.

ex0-white-someones-shadow.arrival: Discard this. Place 1 card face-down from the deck on each of the 12 spaces in a cross from this space. Flip them all face-up.
ex0-white-someones-shadow.hand: Place this face-down on a space that is not adjacent to you.
ex0-white-someones-shadow.flavor: Why has it come to this? (the colorless one, who lent a hand as though it knew something)

ex0-white-dragon.basic:
This card cannot be targeted by other cards' effects.
【Shikija】
{白}Players within 3 spaces draw 2 cards.
{黒}Players within 3 spaces discard their entire hand.
ex0-white-dragon.arrival: Draw 1 card. You are forced to move 1 space.
ex0-white-dragon.hand: Place this face-up on any space.
ex0-white-dragon.flavor: It rages on, and no longer remembers why it cannot be calm.

ex0-black-bad-burger.arrival: Draw 1 card. Choose 1 space with no player among the center and the four corners of the field. Place your entire hand on top of that space.
ex0-black-bad-burger.hand: Discard all cards on any 1 space. Draw 1 card.

ex0-black-vood-contract.arrival: Each player discards down to 2 or fewer cards in hand. If they did, they may lock 1 card from their hand, but not the final lock.

ex0-red-crimson-fist.arrival:
Gain one of the following effects:
・【Color Cost 1】Draw 2 cards.
・Choose 1 opponent adjacent to you. Make contact with that opponent.
ex0-red-crimson-fist.hand:
【Color Cost S】Choose 1 opponent adjacent to you. Make contact with that opponent.
(The number of cards taken by that contact is twice S.)
ex0-red-crimson-fist.flavor: Red does not speak. It simply arrives.
